title: Death and medical respawn evidence promotion gate
action: local-player death, incapacitation, revival, medical respawn, and self-termination evidence investigation

sensitivityHandling.notes: No raw owner capture is committed. The repository contains only the promotion gate and a sanitized noise control fixture.

expectedNonEvents.reason: The single owner-described emergency notification does not establish local-player-specific semantics or repeatable positive evidence.
MedBed and local telemetry initialization are not unique to medical respawn and lack controlled positive and negative captures.
The promising reset sequence has no established correlation identity, boundary, or repeated build coverage.
Backspace is owner annotation only and has no direct or uniquely discriminating log cause marker.
No direct local-player death marker is present in the reviewed repository evidence.
No controlled incapacitation capture distinguishes incapacitation from emergency, revival, or respawn.
No party-assisted revival capture is available.
No repeated direct medical respawn evidence is available.

correlation.notes: Promotion requires bounded environment, session, source-generation, local-identity, and time correlation plus positive and negative fixtures.

knownLimitations: Owner action annotations are not parser evidence.
Party-assisted revival requires another participant and remains externally blocked.
No candidate event is registered in runtime-event/v1 by this issue.
verificationNotes: This manifest is an explicit gate: tests must ensure every candidate remains unpromoted until controlled captures and contract review establish meaning.
